data.summary:
Seasoned Process Excellence Leader with around 14 years of experience driving process optimization, digital innovation & quality transformation across the BPO and healthcare domains.
Proven track record in leading enterprise-wide Lean Six Sigma initiatives, delivering measurable improvements in cost efficiency, process standardization, and service quality.
Strong expertise in digital transformation, Gen AI & RPA enablement, and data-driven decision-making, enabling scalable and sustainable business process improvements.
Adept at partnering with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to design and implement governance frameworks, operating models, and continuous improvement strategies.
Demonstrated success in managing large, high-performing teams, fostering a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
Strategic thinker with strong capabilities in project management, risk mitigation, and business process re-engineering, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and industry best practices.
NOTABLE ACHIEVEMENTS
Successfully delivered 3 Lean Six Sigma Black Belt projects, 7 Green Belt projects and 15 Kaizen initiatives improving operational efficiency and customer experience.
Led Enterprise Workflow Management Tool transformation across 2 countries impacting 2,000 employees resulting in approximately US $1 Million business savings.
Spearheaded Generative AI initiatives including Knowledge Management Chatbot and AI-powered Payment Data Capture Solution.
Implemented UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate based automation initiatives reducing manual effort and improving productivity.
Leveraged Celonis Process Mining to identify process bottlenecks and automation opportunities enabling data-driven Process Excellence.
Delivered measurable business outcomes through cost savings, productivity improvement, FTE optimization, revenue enablement and cost avoidance.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Cognizant Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd, Hyderabad Manager - Process Excellence Team Manager - Process Excellence | Mar 2022 - Dec 2025
Jan 2026 - Present
Key Result Areas:

Served as Process Excellence Manager leading Enterprise Process Excellence, Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) and Digital Transformation initiatives across multiple business units.

Led Lean Six Sigma deployment using DMAIC, Process Mapping, Root Cause Analysis and Continuous Improvement methodologies to optimize business processes.

Successfully delivered 3 Black Belt projects, 7 Green Belt projects and 15 Kaizen initiatives driving productivity improvement, cost optimization and operational excellence.
•
Led Digital Transformation initiatives by identifying automation opportunities using UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate, preparing BRDs, business cases and implementation roadmaps.

Leveraged Celonis Process Mining to identify bottlenecks, process deviations and automation opportunities enabling data- driven process optimization.

Delivered Knowledge Management Chatbot using Generative AI improving access to SOPs, knowledge articles and operational documentation.

Led enterprise Workflow Management Tool transformation across 2 countries impacting over 2,000 employees delivering approximately US $1 Million business savings through workflow standardization and automation.

Designed AI-powered Payment Data Capture Solution automating payment information extraction and validation reducing manual effort.

Established governance mechanisms through KPI dashboards, executive reporting, transformation governance, risk monitoring and benefits realization.

Presented weekly Process Excellence updates to Director-level stakeholders and monthly transformation reviews to Vice Presidents and senior leadership.

Conducted cross-functional workshops, change management sessions and process improvement reviews supporting successful transformation adoption.

Data Analytics & Insights: Analyzed operational data to identify root causes of issues and recommended actionable solutions to senior management.
Omega Healthcare Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru Process Lead - Quality Assurance Quality Control Analyst | Aug 2014 - Sep 2017
Sep 2017 - Jan 2022
Key Result Areas:

Quality Governance: Designed and maintained quality control frameworks, KPIs, and risk management protocols to ensure operational excellence.

Root Cause Analysis: Conducted investigations to identify underlying causes of process non-conformities and implemented corrective actions.

Process Optimization: Led continuous improvement initiatives, integrating technology and best practices to enhance operational efficiency.

Stakeholder Communication: Regularly reported progress, escalations, and risk insights to senior management and collaborated to implement solutions.

Team Leadership: Managed a 50-member quality team, providing training, mentorship, and guidance on process adherence and best practices.

Process Monitoring: Supervised daily operations to ensure SLA compliance and workflow efficiency.

Quality Assessment: Evaluated errors, performed trend analysis, and implemented preventive measures to improve service quality.

Process Review & Recommendation: Partnered with leadership to audit operations, identify gaps, and recommend actionable improvements.

Staff Mentorship: Trained and guided junior staff on quality standards, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
EXL Pvt. Ltd., Cochin AR Analyst
July 2013 - July 2014
Key Result Areas:

Accounts Receivable Management: Verified insurance eligibility, managed follow-ups, and resolved billing discrepancies to ensure timely payments.

Stakeholder Coordination: Maintained strong relationships with internal and external clients, ensuring compliance and accuracy in financial transactions.

Performance Recognition: Awarded Star Performer consecutively for Feb'14 and Mar'14 for exceptional work quality and client satisfaction.
lenergizer India Pvt. Ltd., Noida Customer Support Executive - Xerox Process
Apr 2012 - Nov 2012
Key Result Areas:

Remote Troubleshooting: Provided technical support, ticket management, and resolution for client operations.

Documentation & Reporting: Maintained accurate records of customer interactions, complaints, and resolutions.
•
Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborated with engineers and internal teams to ensure timely resolution of complex customer issues.
